purpose: One bounded historical option-bar access probe using existing Alpaca paper credentials against the data host only. No orders, account changes or paid services.
selection_reason: Three fixed round strikes, calls and puts, a standard monthly expiration and a short interval in Alpaca's first documented availability month. This is an access fixture, not a profitable contract selection or strategy.
pagination: Record any next_page_token; do not follow during this probe.
qualification: Bars aggregate trades and do not supply verified bid/ask execution prices, spreads, contract deliverables, multipliers, complete chains or cost-qualified returns. The endpoint has no documented feed parameter. Do not label its response verified OPRA quotes.
